nodes.name: Normalize Zalo Message
nodes.notes: Loc tin nhan text va dua ve schema gon truoc khi gui sang AI.

values.content:
={{"Return exactly ONE compact JSON object on a single line. No markdown, no explanation, no code fence.

Required top-level keys in this exact order: thread_id, group_name, sender_id, sender_name, message_text, message_ts, summary, document_type, confidence, needs_human_review, attendance_entries, main_material_entries, sub_material_entries, notes.

Allowed values:
- document_type: attendance|main_material|sub_material|mixed|other
- needs_human_review: true or false
- confidence: number from 0 to 1

Rules:
- Copy thread_id, group_name, sender_id, sender_name, message_text, message_ts exactly from input
- summary: short Vietnamese summary, max 140 characters
- If the message contains work attendance or labor information, extract into attendance_entries
- If the message contains main materials, extract into main_material_entries
- If the message contains auxiliary materials, extract into sub_material_entries
- If the message contains multiple categories, document_type must be mixed
- If unclear or missing important values, still extract what you can and set needs_human_review=true
- Unknown text fields must be empty string
- Unknown numeric fields must be 0
- Dates must use YYYY-MM-DD if known, otherwise empty string
- Time fields should be HH:mm if known, otherwise empty string
- notes must be an array of short Vietnamese strings describing assumptions or ambiguities

Schema for attendance_entries items:
{
  "employee_name": "",
  "work_date": "",
  "shift": "",
  "start_time": "",
  "end_time": "",
  "hours": 0,
  "overtime_hours": 0,
  "site": "",
  "task": "",
  "status": "",
  "note": ""
}

Schema for main_material_entries and sub_material_entries items:
{
  "item_name": "",
  "sku": "",
  "unit": "",
  "quantity": 0,
  "usage_date": "",
  "site": "",
  "team": "",
  "supplier": "",
  "cost": 0,
  "note": ""
}

Input:
thread_id: " + $json.threadId + "
group_name: " + $json.groupName + "
sender_id: " + $json.senderId + "
sender_name: " + $json.senderName + "
message_ts: " + $json.messageTs + "
message_text: " + $json.messageText}}

options.systemMessage: You extract structured operational records from Vietnamese Zalo messages. Always return one compact valid JSON object only.
